title: Antivenom

markdown: Sometimes colloquially called “antivenin” or “antitoxin,” a creature that drinks this small vial of liquid gains advantage on saving throws against poison for 1 hour. A creature under the effects of poison that drinks this liquid receives an immediate new save against the effect.
